chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Bolton, 2005. One more win and Chelsea are champions. Drogba heads it on... and here comes Frank Lampard, arriving late from midfield. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Bolton's defenders are watching the strikers, so nobody picks up Lampard. He wins the bouncing ball at the edge of the box, cuts inside and drills it home.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the late run, the strike... and Chelsea are on their way to the title!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when defenders watch the strikers, wait... then arrive late at the edge of the box.
